scope: Standalone prototype only; not linked into the production runtime.
quantization: symmetric int8 weights and dynamic int8 inputs with per-tensor scales, AVX512 VNNI dpbusd
conclusion: The VNNI matrix kernel reaches the requested 10us scale for GEMM only, but complete recurrent inference remains about 30us after quantization, dequantization, activation, GRU state update, and LayerNorm.
